title: Trending Domains and Business Ideas: the open names of the daily editions
description:
Search trends paired with a domain name that was still open on the day, and for founders a business idea written for the trend. Every morning at 06:00 UTC, Unique.domains publishes two editions: Trending Domains (https://unique.domains/trending-domains), for domain investors, and Business Ideas (https://unique.domains/business-ideas), for founders. Each edition names the trends rising in search and one domain name for each trend.

This dataset holds the five names each edition opens to every reader, for the newest 90 editions of each page, in the edition's own order; it never ranks or scores them. A row gives the trend with its monthly searches and its growth, the domain name, and the name's status and price on the day the edition was published.

The files are trending-domains.csv, trending-domains.json, business-ideas.csv and business-ideas.json, with a data dictionary that describes every column. The GitHub repository refreshes them every night, and this record holds them as they were on the day of its release.

The Unique.domains API serves the latest edition at GET https://api.unique.domains/v1/editions/{persona}/latest, with no key. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api.
